content: I was really excited to try this foam mattress, but it turned out to be a huge disappointment. The mattress is far too firm and offers almost no pressure relief, making it uncomfortable to sleep on. Despite the claims of good airflow, I found it traps heat, leaving me sweaty and restless throughout the night. After just a few weeks, the mattress started to develop noticeable body impressions and sagging in the middle. The smell upon unboxing was overwhelming and took over two weeks to dissipate completely. Customer service was unhelpful when I reached out about my concerns, offering no satisfactory solutions. Considering the high price, I expected a much better quality product that would last longer. Overall, I do not recommend this mattress for anyone seeking comfort and durability.
